zh.name: tasks

讓未授權者看不懂資料
AES、Twofish、RSA 加密

items.body:
讓雙方取得共同金鑰

en.name: tasks
en.caption: Four principal cryptographic tasks
en.description: These are parallel tasks. A bare hash does not authenticate a sender; a signature does not directly provide confidentiality. Mechanisms are commonly combined.

items.title: Confidentiality
items.body:
Keep data unreadable to unauthorized parties
AES, Twofish, RSA encryption

items.title: Key establishment
items.body:
Establish shared keying material
DH, ECDH, RSA-based schemes

items.title: Integrity
items.body:
Check whether data changed
Hashes, MACs, digital signatures

items.title: Authentication
items.body:
Check the relationship to a trusted party
Digital signatures, PKI

items.title: 整碟加密 Full Disk Encryption

en.name: storage
en.caption: Three storage-encryption scopes
en.description: These are parallel scopes, not a deployment sequence. Arrows that could imply ordering in the reference are omitted. Classification follows NIST SP 800-111.

items.title: Full disk encryption
items.body: Protect disk or system-disk data against device loss, theft and offline access

items.title: Volume / container encryption
items.body: Protect a partition or virtual disk; once mounted it can be used like a normal disk

items.title: File encryption
items.body: Selectively protect files or folders; this is not full disk encryption

zh.name: hidden
zh.caption: VeraCrypt Hidden Volume 概念圖

items.title: 外層加密磁碟區 Outer Volume

items.title: 內層隱藏磁碟區 Hidden Volume

en.name: hidden
en.caption: VeraCrypt hidden-volume concept
en.description: Nesting denotes storage containment, not inherited unlocking. Plausible deniability is not guaranteed invisibility; temporary files, snapshots and outer-volume writes still need attention.

items.title: Outer encrypted volume

items.title: Hidden volume
items.body: Occupies free space inside the outer volume and uses a different password; unlocking the outer volume does not unlock it
